title: A deserialization type-restriction control in the BSON serialization component can be bypassed because the check used…
description: A vulnerability in the BSON serialization component allows bypassing a type-restriction control due to an overly permissive heuristic used to identify compiler-generated types. This flaw enables an attacker who can supply BSON content to cause the deserialization of types outside the intended allow-list, potentially leading to unexpected object states and errors in application logic. Exploitation requires only the ability to influence the deserialization input and does not require elevated privileges.
